{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from PBS

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# PBS resources:
#   -P QCL_PT
#   -l select=1:ncpus=1:ngpus=1:mem=30GB
#   -l walltime=24:00:00
#   -q defaultQ

#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=24h

# Omitted PBS option: -l ngpus=1
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may start without a GPU, causing failure or severe slowdown.

# Omitted PBS option: -l mem=30GB
# Flux memory requests are site/config dependent and not universally portable.
# Performance implication: job may be scheduled on a node with insufficient memory, risking OOM kills or degraded performance.

# Omitted PBS option: -P QCL_PT (project/account)
# Flux accounting/project selection is site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may be charged to a default project/account or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted PBS option: -q defaultQ (queue)
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run with different priority/limits or on different hardware (or be rejected by policy).

module load cuda/10.0.130
module load openmpi-gcc/3.1.3

source miniconda/bin/activate training

cd models/

python research/object_detection/model_main_tf2.py \
  --model_dir="/project/RDS-FSC-QCL_PT-RW/rcnn_model_data/" \
  --num_train_steps=200000 \
  --sample_1_of_n_eval_examples=1 \
  --pipeline_config_path=pipeline.config \
  --alsologtostder
"
}
